description.value: Penticton Indian Cuisine is a family-owned restaurant run by Nepalese chefs Dambar and Sita Khatri, who honed their craft in New Delhi, Cyprus, and Tokyo before settling in Penticton. The menu blends authentic Indian classics like butter chicken and rogan josh with Nepalese specialties such as momos and sekuwa, complemented by local BC wine. Located on Main Street in the heart of Penticton, it offers a cozy and contemporary dining room with a broad menu spanning vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and provides address, phone, and rich menu/about details. The menu page explicitly states 'From gluten free to dairy free to vegan options,' confirming dietary accommodations. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, takeout, or Wi-Fi anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those remain null. OSM had no phone or address to cross-check, but the website URL matches the OSM url field.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant on Main Street in Penticton with a live website, full menu, and contact details. Straightforwardly useful to touring cyclists seeking a sit-down meal.
